replies.text: The memory part is what I want to read first. How are you scoping it per agent? I keep going back and forth between one shared store and something narrower per deployment.
Canvas built by a plugin the agent calls is a neat idea. Does the agent get a fixed set of drawing calls, or can it write arbitrary canvas code?
Diff sheets and recorded check outcomes in chat is the part I would actually use. What does the Linux toolchain look like on device? Straight proot, or something lighter?
Anything that destroys something it cannot restore. Deleting backups, force-pushing a shared branch, dropping a table. I can review a bad email. I cannot review a lost commit.
